title: FLUX.2 Klein 9B edit, guided by a depth picture
description: Like "FLUX.2 Klein 9B edit, up to five pictures" (flux2-klein-9b-da-edit), plus a depth picture of image 1 (Depth Anything V2 Small, the Depth pack this template offers to install) sent right after it, as image 2: the model sees image 1 itself and its depth, so the subject keeps its look and its pose. Your other pictures follow as images 3 to 6. Name the depth in the prompt ("Image 2 is the depth map of image 1: keep its pose"). The DA workflow's "Controlnet" sends the depth instead of image 1; Fugue sends both. Bypass the Depth Estimate node to leave the depth out; use the plain edit template when you do not need depth.
